newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firm, fuel barges slip.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firm, fuel barges slip.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Friday but fuel oil barges were down on aggressive selling.

Gas oil firmed around $2 on stronger benchmark IPE futures and premiums for heating oil including Russian, and for low sulphur diesel remained steady despite indications of increased supply, traders said.

Gasoline prices recovered from Thursday's sharp drop after crude rallied. Unleaded premium barges were quoted $227/$229 fob ARA. Naphtha was unchanged but traders noted demand for heavy grades for making gasoline.
